record_title: A two-dimensional phase law for determinant comparisons of |AB| and |BA|
provenance: The proof diagonalizes the positive factor A, uses the shared singular spectrum of AB and BA, reduces real powers of the two positive 2×2 Gram matrices to a divided-difference affine formula, and evaluates the resulting determinant gap exactly.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is genuinely two-dimensional and does not resolve the higher-dimensional conjectures. The literature search included the original Lin determinant problem, the 2020/2021 Hermitian determinant papers, Ghabries's 2022 thesis, and the 2026 normal-matrix extension; older low-dimensional matrix-inequality literature could still contain an equivalent observation.
